modules.title: Custom Web & SaaS Development
modules.subtitle: Enterprise-grade web systems engineered for scale, concurrency, and security.
modules.description: We design and build complete cloud architectures from the schema layer to server-driven interfaces. Every platform is built for resilience under traffic spikes, multi-tenant data isolation, and low-latency interaction.

capabilities.label: Database & Schema Architecture
capabilities.detail: PostgreSQL & TimescaleDB modeling with connection pooling, migrations, and strict indexing.

capabilities.label: REST & GraphQL API Design
capabilities.detail: Type-safe RPC contracts with Zod validation, rate limiting, and OpenAPI specifications.

capabilities.label: SSR / SSG & Edge Routing
capabilities.detail: Next.js App Router with React Server Components, streaming suspense, and CDN edge caching.

capabilities.label: Auth & Enterprise RBAC
capabilities.detail: OAuth2, WebAuthn passkeys, multi-factor security, and granular permission matrices.

capabilities.label: Billing & Subscription Engines
capabilities.detail: Stripe Billing, usage-based metering, webhook reconciliation, and automated invoicing.

modules.title: Mobile Engineering
modules.subtitle: Hardware-accelerated mobile apps for iOS and Android from a single shared TypeScript core.
modules.description: We avoid sluggish web-wrappers. We build high-performance mobile apps using React Native and Expo with native platform modules, offline-first SQLite sync, and buttery-smooth 60fps gestures.

capabilities.label: Cross-Platform Single Codebase
capabilities.detail: React Native with 90%+ code sharing between iOS and Android without sacrificing platform UX.

capabilities.label: Offline-First SQLite Synchronization
capabilities.detail: Local-first persistence with deterministic conflict-free replication when network returns.

capabilities.label: Push Notifications & Background Tasks
capabilities.detail: APNs & FCM integration with automated user notification schedules and silent sync workers.

capabilities.label: Biometric & Secure Enclave Security
capabilities.detail: FaceID, TouchID, and Android BiometricPrompt with cryptographic hardware token storage.

capabilities.label: App Store & Google Play Compliance
capabilities.detail: Full handling of review audits, privacy manifests, EAS CI/CD build channels, and rollout flags.

modules.title: UI/UX & Product Strategy
modules.subtitle: Precision interface systems designed to bridge product vision and production code.
modules.description: Design without technical grounding leads to broken implementations. We design in tight coordination with engineering constraints, delivering tokenized design systems, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, and click-through prototypes.

capabilities.label: Wireframing & Information Architecture
capabilities.detail: User journey mapping, state charts, and ergonomic screen hierarchy before visual styling.

capabilities.label: Design Tokens & System Architecture
capabilities.detail: Semantic color ramps, typography scales, and spacing tokens synced from Figma directly to code.

capabilities.label: Production Figma Component Libraries
capabilities.detail: Strict auto-layout, nested variant sets, and dev-mode ready assets with zero ambiguity.

capabilities.label: Usability & Accessibility Audits
capabilities.detail: Screen-reader audits, contrast validation, and keyboard navigation testing across viewports.

modules.title: MVP Accelerator
modules.subtitle: 6-week fixed-scope delivery designed for pre-seed and seed stage startups.
modules.description: Speed is oxygen for early ventures. The MVP Accelerator eliminates scope creep and engineering paralysis. We lock a clear specification, ship working builds every 14 days, and launch a production product ready for real paying users.

capabilities.label: Week 1–2: Architecture & Specification
capabilities.detail: System design, core data schemas, wireframes, and fixed delivery contract agreement.

capabilities.label: Week 3–4: Core Feature Sprint
capabilities.detail: Authentication, primary user workflows, external API integrations, and database migrations.

capabilities.label: Week 5: Polish, Billing & Edge Cases
capabilities.detail: Stripe checkout, responsive optimization, error logging, and analytics instrumentation.

capabilities.label: Week 6: Production Launch & Handover
capabilities.detail: DNS cutover, security audit, documentation runbooks, and 100% intellectual property transfer.
